newsitem.title: USA: Personal submarine for the man who has everything.
newsitem.headline: Personal submarine for the man who has everything.

text.p: Pete Hoffmann, a Florida yacht broker who caters to the whims of the wealthy, has the latest must-have accessory for the very rich: personal submarines for a mere $500,000.
Hoffman took a tiny research submarine and spent the last two years converting it into the ultimate underwater luxury craft c with big viewing windows, air conditioning and a CD player.
"It is a labour of love," he said.

In about a month, the buyer -- who insists on anonymity -- will have the sub hanging from his 150-foot yacht, which also sports a hovercraft. The new accessory is 13 feet (4 metres) long, weighs 12,000 pounds (5,440 kg) and can hum along at 2 mph (3.2 kph).

The sub, which seats five comfortably, costs $500,000 plus $300,000 more for the yacht-board equipment to carry and launch it. Hoffmann has formed Submarines Inc. to build more compact subs for the wealthy as well as for researchers and companies that might use them for oil exploration and other more serious jobs.
But Hoffmann might take some tips from his wealthy clients. He says he spent $600,000 on the submarine and is losing money on the deal.
